behavior: Invoices can be paid and settled on Arbitrum Sepolia, enabled on its own after the Base Sepolia gate
acceptance: D-38: migration 00015 adds Arbitrum Sepolia and its token 0x75faf114eafb1BDbe2F0316DF893fd58CE46AA4d (USDC, 6 decimals) switched off, so test and fresh databases need no Arbitrum RPC or gas; docs/backend/architecture.md gives the SQL that turns a chain on per database, and the local database has it on; the R-15 vectors cover its chain ID; the pay page and dashboard show its network name; a backend test proves invoices are refused while it is off and work with network name, symbol and decimals once it is on
D-38: the existing Base Sepolia invoices and pay page are unchanged; the e2e and backend checks pass
notes: 2026-10-10 Gate: start only after PLAN 8.12 (complete money-path review and Sasha's Base Sepolia run). Before done, Sasha runs create, pay, settled on this chain and the tx hashes go in a note.

2026-10-11 decision: chains are added switched off by migration and turned on per database; a migration that enables a chain would make every test and fresh database fail the D-71 startup checks without that chain's RPCs and executor gas

2026-10-11 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Switched-off-by-migration is correct: chain.CheckEnabled (internal/chain/check.go:19) stops api, worker and signer when an enabled chain is missing from CHAINS_FILE or lacks two answering RPCs, and the signer adds executor gas (cmd/signer/main.go:57); e2e/gate_test.go:62 writes an Anvil-only chain list, so an enabling migration would break the gate and fresh dev databases. 00015: lowercase contract matches the tokens CHECK (00002_money.sql:25); token on chain is USDC, 6 decimals (cast call); ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING keeps a hand-inserted 421614 row unchanged; Down deletes token then chain, and the invoices FK blocks Down once invoices exist. Local forwend DB is at version 15 with 421614 chain and token enabled. vectors/receive-address.json covers 421614; web chains.ts:23 and pay.ts:19 already list Arbitrum USDC; packages/contracts unchanged. networks_test.go passes and fails without 00015 (copy of the backend with the file removed: 'token is not enabled on this chain'). architecture.md:137-141 enable SQL is correct. Verify logs 20261011T131648Z all pass. Note: architecture.md:137 'Migrations add each planned network' does not describe Base Sepolia, which is still only a hand-inserted row. The live Arbitrum create/pay/settle run with tx hashes from the task note is still due before done.
2026-10-11 owner said not to wait: merged with the chain off by default and on only in the local database; the owner's live Arbitrum Sepolia create, pay, settled run and its tx hashes are still owed

proof.1: backend: migration 00015 adds Arbitrum Sepolia and its USDC switched off; invoice TestPlannedNetworksTakeInvoicesOnceEnabled proves create is refused while off and works with network arbitrum-sepolia, USDC, 6 decimals once on; vectors/receive-address.json already holds chain 421614 (R-15 test) and apps/web chains.ts names it; architecture.md gives the enable SQL; locally enabled, and the api, worker and signer passed their D-71 startup checks with it on
proof.2: e2e: Base Sepolia invoice, pay page and dashboard browser tests pass unchanged; backend check passes with the new migration
